dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Tenzin arrived at MACC following a bite incident. Tenzin was fed next to another MMB which resulted in the two dogs beginning to fight. When someone attempted to separate the dogs, they got bitten on the left forearm. They are unsure which dog bit them on the arm. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only, single pet home that makes no trips to the dog park.
dog.name: Tenzin
